entries.title: Six Digits
entries.ai_quote: Six Digits: the Color Guessing Game remade as a daily paint chip

gameplay.input: Focused the Hue slider inside the iframe and pressed ArrowRight once. Clicked Stamp inside the iframe.
gameplay.response: The live status region showed Target #1460B6 versus Yours #4ECE38, score 0.4/10, and feedback “Too green, Too grey, Too light.”

entries.title: Color Flood
entries.ai_quote: Color Flood: remade as a risograph flood puzzle with par, stars, 40 levels and a daily board

gameplay.input: Clicked the visible button “Pink, swallows 2 cells.” inside the iframe.
gameplay.response: Move count changed from 0 to 1; visible status read “Pink swallowed 2 cells. Move 1 of 6, par 3.”

entries.title: Bedtime (Lights Out)
entries.ai_quote: Remake Lights Out as Bedtime: put a street to sleep, one block at a time

gameplay.input: Clicked “Window 1 on floor 3” inside the iframe.
gameplay.response: The targeted window changed from an unlit state (class w) to illuminated (class w pv on); the rendered house showed that window lit.

entries.title: Stack Tower
entries.ai_quote: Stack Tower: remade as a climb from dawn to the stars, with a tested cut

gameplay.input: Clicked the center of the game canvas twice inside the restricted iframe.
gameplay.response: The score changed from 0 to 1 and then 2; the iframe showed two stacked slabs. Final frame URL remained https://www.gptgames.dev/games/stack_tower.html.

entries.title: Glowtide
entries.ai_quote: The game is now a single-tap chain puzzle in a dark sea

gameplay.input: Clicked “Free dive” inside the iframe. On the first board, clicked an orange orb; it lit 2 of 3 and the game responded “1 short / You lit 2, the tide needed 3.” Retried and clicked the central orb in the new board.
gameplay.response: The first iframe action produced a visible 2/3 count and failure response. On retry, the chosen orb’s chain reaction reached 3 / CLEAR and displayed “Goal reached.” Final frame URL remained https://www.gptgames.dev/games/chain_reaction.html.

entries.title: Tower of Hanoi
entries.ai_quote: Remake Tower of Hanoi: a night temple where every disc is a bell and the lantern marks the goal

gameplay.input: Clicked the top disc labeled 1, then clicked the empty middle peg inside the iframe.
gameplay.response: The disc moved from the left peg to the middle peg; the move counter changed from 0/7 to 1/7. Final frame URL remained https://www.gptgames.dev/games/tower_of_hanoi.html.
